section.title: TplAppLogsVerbose Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: This class provides methods to generate and manage the logs verbosity menu and actions within the Bearsampp application. It includes functionalities for creating the logs verbosity menu and processing actions to switch the logs verbosity level.
